name: NASA ORNL AVIRIS-NG header bridge for untouched JPL COVID and Permian train backgrounds
research_question: Can public NASA AVIRIS-NG L1B ENVI headers be proven geometrically interchangeable with the JPL CMF crop-index grid, then recover exact UTC and WGS84 centers for an independent COVID-plus-Permian train-background cohort with at least 20 non-protected 25 km components?

decision_context_disclosed_before_freeze.anti_threshold_shopping_boundary: CACH4 rows and components are excluded from this new cohort and cannot be pooled with COVID or Permian to satisfy the gate. The >=20-component threshold, 25 km radius, official-test protection, prior-pair deduplication, and later >=28-pair target gate are unchanged.
decision_context_disclosed_before_freeze.reason_for_new_route: The released multicampaign definition already contained COVID and Permian train cohorts, but exact coordinates were unavailable until discovery of NASA's public per-flightline AVIRIS-NG L1B ENVI headers.

authoritative_metadata_source.provider: NASA ORNL DAAC via Common Metadata Repository
authoritative_metadata_source.collection_title: AVIRIS-NG L1B Calibrated Radiance, Facility Instrument Collection, V1
authoritative_metadata_source.source_description: NASA describes each L1B flightline as an orthocorrected ENVI image accompanied by a text .hdr holding samples, lines, projection, and map information.
authoritative_metadata_source.use_constraint: NASA Earth Science Data and Information Policy as linked by the collection UMM metadata

permitted: NASA CMR collection and granule UMM JSON for explicit train flight IDs
NASA ORNL public or Earthdata-authenticated text .hdr sidecars for orthocorrected L1B img granules
HTTP headers, content lengths, checksums, and redirects needed to verify those text sidecars
forbidden: any AVIRIS-NG binary image, retrieval raster, label raster, GLT, IGM, LOC, OBS, browse image, KML, or bulk archive
any JPL released test definition, outcome, or raster
any MARS protected outcome field, mask, prediction, score, or threshold result
any Sentinel-2 or Landsat target-catalog query or target asset
any EMIT campaign definition or asset

stage_a_cach4_grid_bridge.anchors: All 124 CACH4 train flight IDs in the hash-bound public JPL header manifest are queried against the frozen NASA collection.
stage_a_cach4_grid_bridge.granule_match: A flight ID must resolve to exactly one orthocorrected L1B radiance img ENVI header. Ambiguous or non-img products are unresolved, never chosen heuristically.

grid_comparison.projected_crs: same WGS84 UTM zone and hemisphere
grid_comparison.pixel_size: same sample and line vector lengths within 1e-6 relative tolerance
grid_comparison.points_compared: pixel centers at four image corners and image center after both ENVI map-info records are converted with the GDAL rotation convention

stage_a_cach4_grid_bridge.pass: At least 100 anchors and at least 80% of all 124 anchors resolve, and every resolved anchor satisfies every grid comparison with no mismatch.
stage_a_cach4_grid_bridge.failure_action: Stop. Do not infer COVID or Permian crop coordinates and do not query a target satellite catalog.

stage_b_covid_permian_metadata.row_interpretation: For released filenames ending tile{width}x{height}+A+B.tif, A is ENVI sample/column and B is ENVI line/row, as verified from the released source sampler and CACH4 header dimensions. The crop center is sample A+width/2, line B+height/2.
stage_b_covid_permian_metadata.edge_policy: The released sampler pads overhanging windows. A row is valid only when its center is inside the source grid; full-window overhang is recorded separately.
stage_b_covid_permian_metadata.coordinate_conversion: Use the NASA L1B ENVI affine with GDAL rotation convention, then convert WGS84 UTM to EPSG:4326.
eligibility_filters: coordinate is resolved by a Stage-A-approved NASA header
crop center is inside the source grid
strictly farther than 25 km from every official MARS-S2L test representative location
strictly farther than 25 km from every already-counted MARS-Hyperspectral negative source crop
stage_b_covid_permian_metadata.grouping: Connected components of eligible crop centers, with an undirected edge at haversine distance <=25.0 km; each transitive component counts once.
stage_b_covid_permian_metadata.pass: All metadata gates pass on COVID and Permian alone. CACH4 cannot contribute rows or components.
stage_b_covid_permian_metadata.failure_action: Retire the JPL operational-GHG negative supplement without changing a threshold and seek a different source.

claim_boundary: A PASS would establish metadata and acquisition feasibility only. It would not establish coincident target yield, local methane-label observability, cross-sensor validity, model complementarity, calibration, or superiority over MARS-S2L.
